title: Flaggo Problem Details (RFC 9457) with Phase 1 extensions
description: RFC 9457 application/problem+json body plus Flaggo-stable extension members. Programs branch on `code`, HTTP `status`, and structured issue fields, never on `title`, `detail`, or messages. Retry-After metadata never implies SDK-local fallback eligibility; `clientFallback.eligible: true` must be explicit. Additional members are permitted per RFC 9457 forward compatibility.

type.description: A URI reference identifying the problem type.

title.description: Human-readable summary. Never used for program logic.

status.description: HTTP status code generated on this occurrence.

detail.description: Human-readable explanation. Never used for program logic.

instance.description: URI reference identifying the specific occurrence.

code.description: Stable machine-readable Flaggo error code (kebab-case). Clients branch on this.

correlationId.description: Echoed or server-recorded correlation identifier for tracing.

issues.description: Structured, machine-readable issues. Clients branch on issue `code` and structured fields.

retryAfterSeconds.description: Advisory retry delay mirrored from the Retry-After header where applicable.

path.description: JSON Pointer to the offending location.

message.description: Human-readable message. Not used for program logic.

ClientFallbackEligibility.description: SDK availability-fallback eligibility extension. `eligible: true` is required before an SDK may return a local value for an otherwise-eligible transport/status failure; SDK-local availability configuration is still separately required.
